spec.name: Furniture Haunted Cage Lantern
spec.description: A ceiling-hung black iron cage lantern with interlocking chain links, moss-stained corners and a pale green captive spirit. Open angular bars reveal its spectral face. Fits within one block horizontally; ceiling attachment reaches y=31.75. No stand or animation.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: ceiling-hung black iron cage lantern on a chain with an eerie pale green glowing spirit inside, angular bars, mossy metal corners and no floor stand. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Ceiling attachment: suspension points reach y=31.75, artwork hanging below. No ground support. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
